title: gentianopsis virgata subsp. victorinii
intro: Gentianopsis virgata subsp. victorinii, commonly known as Victor's gentian, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the gentian family. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Victor's gentian include soothing the stomach and alleviating nausea, as well as exhibiting antibacterial and antiviral properties. Research suggests that the bioactive constituents of Gentianopsis virgata subsp. victorinii may include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids.
